title: Generative diffusion models for spatiotemporal influenza forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2604.24913v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Forecasting infectious disease incidence can provide important information to guide public health planning, yet it is difficult because epidemic dynamics are complex. Current mechanistic and statistical approaches often struggle to capture multimodal uncertainty or emergent trends. Influpaint adapts denoising diffusion probabilistic models to epidemic forecasting. By encoding influenza seasons as spatiotemporal images in which pixel intensity represents incidence, Influpaint learns a rich distribution of disease dynamics from a hybrid dataset of surveillance and simulated trajectories. Forecasting is formulated as a conditional generation (inpainting) task from partial observations. We show that Influpaint generates realistic, diverse epidemic trajectories and achieves forecast accuracy that is competitive with leading ensemble methods in retrospective evaluation. translated_title: 用于流感时空预测的生成扩散模型
translated_abstract: 预测传染病发病率可以为公共卫生规划提供重要信息，但由于疫情动态的复杂性，预测十分困难。当前的机制模型和统计方法往往难以捕捉多模态不确定性或新出现的趋势。Influpaint 将去噪扩散概率模型应用于疫情预测。通过将流感季节编码为时空图像（其中像素强度表示发病率），Influpaint 从监测数据和模拟轨迹组成的混合数据集中学习丰富的疾病动态分布。预测被表述为基于部分观测数据的条件生成（图像修复）任务。我们表明，Influpaint 能够生成逼真、多样的疫情轨迹，并在回顾性评估中取得了与领先集成方法具有竞争力的预测准确性。在2023-2025年美国CDC FluSight挑战赛的实时评估中……
tldr: Influpaint 将去噪扩散概率模型创新性地应用于流感时空预测，通过将流感季节编码为时空图像并把预测转化为条件生成（图像修复）任务，生成了逼真多样的疫情轨迹，预测准确性可与领先的集成方法相媲美。
